explanation: The copper(I) oxide formed by roasting reacts further with remaining copper(I) sulphide to give metallic copper directly, completing the extraction of copper from its ore by heating alone.

beaker_view.initial_appearance: A mixture of red copper(I) oxide and dark grey copper(I) sulphide.
beaker_view.observation: Heated together, the red oxide and dark sulphide react further, leaving behind reddish-brown metallic copper.
